chain.axiom: God creates.
Creation stands.
Creation is distinguishable.
Distinction carries information.
Information opens moral valence.
Creation has value.
Value makes right and wrong meaningful.
Right and wrong require agents who can choose.
Choice requires a world with rules, limits, time, and consequences.
Rules plus entropy create decay and vulnerability.
Decay opens an adversarial attractor.
The Enemy is the agency that exploits and amplifies that attractor.
Adversarial action creates real moral debt, damage, and disorder.
Perfect Justice requires the debt to be truthfully named and paid.
Perfect Mercy wills restoration rather than terminal rejection.
Justice and Mercy together require an external cost-bearing source.
That source must preserve the record while paying the cost.
That source is Grace.
Grace restores creation toward God.
Christ is the convergence point.

proof_stack.name: Truth
proof_stack.statement: Truth is not inside the system; it makes axioms, definitions, and proofs meaningful.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Deny truth-evaluability while making a truth claim

proof_stack.name: Existence
proof_stack.statement: Something exists rather than nothing.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show coherent absolute nothing producing system without contradiction

proof_stack.name: Distinction
proof_stack.statement: What exists is distinguishable.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show structure with no distinguishable difference

proof_stack.name: Information
proof_stack.statement: Information is the presence of distinguishable states.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show information without distinguishable states

proof_stack.name: Moral Field / Valence
proof_stack.statement: Once distinguishable states exist, states can differ in preservation, coherence, damage, and value-direction. Latent moral field, not yet accountability.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show value-relevant distinction impossible before agents

proof_stack.name: Substrate Requirement
proof_stack.statement: Information requires a substrate.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show information existing with no carrier/substrate

proof_stack.name: Self-Grounding
proof_stack.statement: The final substrate must not collapse into infinite regress.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show finite regress that grounds itself without circularity

proof_stack.name: Observation Requirement
proof_stack.statement: Possibility becomes actuality through observation/actualization.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show actualization without any selection/actualization relation

proof_stack.name: Value
proof_stack.statement: Creation/existence has value because chosen existence implies more than nullity and distinguishable preservation/damage.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show value judgment can be denied without using value

proof_stack.name: Right and Wrong
proof_stack.statement: Right/wrong become meaningful when value can be preserved, harmed, repaired, or corrupted.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show moral categories without value

proof_stack.name: Agency / Choice
proof_stack.statement: Right and wrong require agents who can choose to align or misalign.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show moral accountability with zero agency

proof_stack.name: Moral Accountability
proof_stack.statement: Moral accountability arises when agents know moral direction and can choose otherwise.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show accountability without agency or agency with no moral content

proof_stack.name: Three Observers Required
proof_stack.statement: Three observers are minimum triangulating structure with no privileged frame.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show stable self-verifying system with one or two observers

proof_stack.name: Infinite Energy Source
proof_stack.statement: A finite closed system runs down; sustained existence requires inexhaustible source.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show finite closed system sustaining final coherence indefinitely

proof_stack.name: Coherence Cannot Self-Increase
proof_stack.statement: A finite closed system cannot generate final coherence from within itself.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show closed damaged system fully restoring itself

proof_stack.name: Law / Boundary Conditions
proof_stack.statement: Choice requires a lawful world with rules, limits, time, and consequences.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show meaningful choice in a world with no rules or consequences

proof_stack.name: Entropy / Decay
proof_stack.statement: Rules plus finitude permit decay, drift, and vulnerability.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show finite bounded system immune to all decay/vulnerability

proof_stack.name: Adversarial Attractor
proof_stack.statement: Decay opens a path away from coherence — an attractor, not personal agency by itself.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show decay cannot create exploitable incoherence gradients

proof_stack.name: Enemy / Adversarial Agency
proof_stack.statement: The Enemy is agency that exploits and amplifies the adversarial attractor.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show adversarial agency impossible or irrelevant to decay exploitation

proof_stack.name: Grace External to System
proof_stack.statement: If coherence cannot self-increase and repair is needed, repair must come from outside.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show internal self-repair without external input

proof_stack.name: Grace Operator
proof_stack.statement: External, restorative, record-preserving operation that supplies coherence without falsifying justice.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show restoration without external source, cost, or record preservation

proof_stack.name: Justice-Mercy Operator
proof_stack.statement: Justice and mercy share structure but differ by cost-bearer; Cross is judge-as-payer.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Find perfect mercy where cost genuinely disappears

proof_stack.name: Cross
proof_stack.statement: Unique convergence configuration where justice and mercy both hold without falsifying ledger.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show second stable configuration satisfying same constraints

proof_stack.name: Christ Coherence / χ
proof_stack.statement: Coherence wrapper/integrator; not an ordinary product factor.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show final coherence with one load-bearing integration removed

proof_stack.name: New Creation / Eschaton
proof_stack.statement: Grace restores creation toward God; Christ is final convergence point.
proof_stack.kill_condition: Show restoration incomplete at final coherence
